lines.text: Elihu says the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food, and that Job has declared he is righteous.
Elihu says Job keeps company with the poor and has said a man gains nothing from delighting in God.
Elihu says God repays a man according to his deeds and does not act wickedly or pervert justice.
Elihu says God is not partial to priests, and no darkness exists where the workers of iniquity can hide.
Elihu says Job speaks without knowledge and multiplies his words against God.
